annotations.title: Custom road trip in the Roadcut planner

description: A link that opens the Roadcut planner with a trip from any start to any destination in Europe, optionally through the user's own stops and back home. When opened, the planner works out the road, splits it into driving days with a place to sleep each night, and shows hotels, EV chargers, fuel, vignettes and tolls along the way; the user can then add stops, move nights and change days. The plan is computed in the planner, not returned here. Coordinates make the link exact; without them the planner looks the place names up (and own stops then need coordinates too).

days.description: Days for the whole trip, including any days spent at the destination. Without it the planner uses the pace.

name.description: Place name as the user would say it, e.g. "Brno".

extra_days.description: When `days` is more than the driving needs: spend the spare days at the destination (default) or spread them along the road.

lang.description: Language of the user, for the links (en, de, es, fr, it, cs, da, sv, nb, pl, nl). Default en.

pace.description: Driving per day: easy about 180 km, medium 280 km (default), fast 380 km.

road.description: Which road to take. Default fastest.

round_trip.description: Drive back to the start at the end. Default false.

start.description: Where the trip starts, e.g. the user's home town.

name.description: Place name as the user would say it, e.g. "Brno".

start_date.description: First day of the trip (YYYY-MM-DD), for the weather and pass warnings in the planner.

stops.description: Places to drive through on the way out, each with coordinates. Up to 15.

name.description: Place name as the user would say it, e.g. "Brno".
